topics.name: Canonical Contract Status
topics.purpose: Define contract readiness status as explicit metadata with `unlocked` meaning not yet accepted as closure-complete and `locked` meaning validated against declared readiness criteria.

semantics.unlocked_rule: Unlocked means the contract may be semantically valid but is not yet declared closure-complete under current review criteria.
semantics.locked_rule: Locked means exact readiness criteria/profile were satisfied and the status transition was explicitly accepted.
semantics.semantic_rule: Status does not change the underlying contract identity/ownership semantics.
semantics.runtime_rule: Locked status does not mean runtime enabled/active.
semantics.superseded_rule: Superseded means a newer explicit canonical definition replaces this definition while this identity/revision remains historically traceable.
semantics.deprecated_rule: Deprecated means the definition remains interpretable but new use is discouraged or disallowed according to explicit replacement/migration semantics.

invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority, canonical contract sources, generated projections, historical artifacts and runtime state remain separate identities/roles; no file becomes authoritative merely by name, path order, timestamp or discovery order.
Candidate canonical changes remain inert until exact format validation, identity/reference resolution, semantic diff, applicable governance/authorization and repository acceptance succeed.
